result.title: Joint position error under speed, payload and temperature, UR5
result.quantity: joint position error e = target q - actual q (rad), controller data
result.baseline: B0 per joint: constant error equal to the identification mean
result.model: MotionProof static drive deflection per joint: e = e0 + tau_target / k + (b/2) sign(dq_target) + lag x dq_target (compliance, dead band and a velocity lag of the position loop)
result.acceptance: every joint J1..J6: validation RMSE(model) <= 0.8 x validation RMSE(B0)
result.scope: external system; says nothing about the MotionProof reference gearbox or user hardware
